name: Idol no Nama Haishin
source:
Nakazawa Akane is an idol whose popularity was steadily rising. However, due to her constantly refusing casting couch invitations, her job offers have gradually decreased which led to her living in poverty.

She received a call from her manager who told her that there was a job available for her. She went to the agency and was informed that she would be living in a room with web cameras installed to broadcast her private life and react to the comments from her fans.

Although she was worried about the job, the woman whom she admires and also her rival, Fujishiro Mei, wanted the job that was offered to Akane as well.

Noticing the rivalry between them, the manager decided to give the job to both of them who were motivated by their competitive spirits, and showed them the rooms where they would be living in.

When Akane first started broadcasting and looked at the comments, all she saw were posts filled with indecent contents and ulterior motives. She became stressed as she couldn't accept them.

Then her manager told her to take a look at Mei's broadcast, and when she did, she saw Mei masturbating to increase the number of viewers.

Not wanting to lose to Mei, Akane also began to masturbate in her own broadcast.

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://www.guilty-soft.com/product/namahaishin/#story]Official website[/url]]
